title: nan
authors: Gao H.; Yu Y.; Zhang W.; Wang Y.; Li L.; Li L.; Song L.; Zhang L.
key_contribution: Proposes a fast UAV image localization method in GNSS-denied environments using image sequence relationships and LightGlue feature matching, with positioning errors under 0.5 m.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
